title: Delete the work branch wip/mn-r2-gate-red
context:
Lane merge-notice-r2 left a red-gate work branch. It must never merge. A copy is saved as archive/wip/mn-r2-gate-red at the same commit, 423cf15, so nothing is lost.
Why yours: the cloud git proxy refused the delete push, and no folder on your computer is open to cloud sessions (measured 2026-11-08, git push origin --delete hung up at 23:12 CST and the branch is still on origin; list_computer_folders offers no folder).
steps: Paste the command below in a terminal.

command.powershell:
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh api -X DELETE repos/shivinate7/mailaudit/git/refs/heads/wip/mn-r2-gate-red
command.mac:
gh auth switch -u shivinate7
gh api -X DELETE repos/shivinate7/mailaudit/git/refs/heads/wip/mn-r2-gate-red
